audio_description:
The red Galbadia Garden grinds against Balamb Garden in a wash of turquoise energy.
Rinoa clings to a precarious edge.
A companion's hand seizes hers and pulls her to safety.

context.scene_title: The Battle of the Gardens — the two Gardens collide and Rinoa is caught at the edge and pulled to safety (Disc 2).
locations: The exterior of the colliding Gardens over green countryside and red rocky terrain

characters.name: Rinoa Heartilly
characters.recognition: Dark hair with auburn streaks, pale-blue knit top, blue arm-warmers; shown clinging to a rocky/structural edge and then being grasped and hauled up by a companion in matching blue.

context.summary: The red Galbadia Garden grinds against Balamb Garden in a wash of turquoise energy as the two collide. Rinoa is caught clinging to a precarious edge; a companion's hand seizes hers and pulls her up to safety amid the chaos of the Garden battle.
context.context_note: High confidence on Rinoa and the Garden-collision setting; the rescuer's identity is not clearly visible.
